    const std::size_t n = x.size();

        val = std::conj(val);

    const double scale = 1.0 / static_cast<double>(n);
    hpx::for_each(hpx::execution::par, x.begin(), x.end(), [scale](auto &val) {
        val *= scale;
    });
}
